Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

scSimEvalStudio 0.99.1

  • Synchronized companion version compatibility with scSimEval 0.99.11 and updated high-DPI workflow diagrams (350 DPI), dark-mode contrast styling, and responsive image zoom controls.

scSimEvalStudio 0.99.0

  • Initial Bioconductor release candidate extracted from scSimEval into a dedicated graphical Shiny studio companion package.
  • Provides launch_scSimEval_app() for interactive single-cell RNA-seq, scATAC-seq, and paired/unpaired multiomics benchmarking, result inspection, and report export powered by scSimEval and SingleCellExperiment.
